background_setting: A tree-lined roadside corridor lies beneath a continuous overcast winter sky. Dense dark green shrubs and mature trees border the route, with low structures and an open horizon beyond the vegetation. A partly screened body of reflective water lies behind the shrub-lined pedestrian route, its boundary interrupted by foliage and the planted bank. Steady white snowflakes fall through the air, accompanied by gentle wintry haze in the distance. A thin, uneven white dusting settles on exposed horizontal edges and plant surfaces, leaving underlying textures visible. The water remains liquid, with muted reflections of the sky and adjacent trees; its full extent is concealed by the surrounding vegetation.

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the fisheye view opens on a snowy urban corridor: gray asphalt road runs along the right with pale dashed lane lines receding toward a vanishing point at center-right, a light gray sidewalk curves along the curb bordered by dark green hedges, a light gray aircraft support rises through the left foreground with beige wrapping and a pale securing band, and rotating propeller blades leave long curved traces across the overcast sky. A small dark boxy vehicle is parked near the curb ahead, and a pedestrian in a charcoal upper garment, blue-gray trousers, and dark footwear walks along the lower-middle sidewalk. At 0:01, the pedestrian shifts rightward as the aircraft advances; nearby hedge masses begin sliding across the frame due to forward motion. At 0:02, the pedestrian reaches the center-right portion of the image and a gap behind shrubs begins exposing reflective water beneath the foliage. At 0:03, the water becomes clearly visible through vegetation in the left-middle scene, separate from the nearer sidewalk, while the pedestrian has moved farther right and higher in the image than at the start. At 0:04, the pedestrian remains beside the curb near center-right but sits slightly lower in the final sample than at four seconds; water still peeks through foliage toward the left, and the small vehicle stays ahead. At 0:05, the frame holds steady on this configuration through the last recorded instant at 4.9375 seconds extending to 5.0 seconds. Throughout, white snowflakes fall through open spaces around the aircraft and across the distant road, mild camera bobbing and roll accompany continuous travel, and propeller traces vary in length and curvature across the sky.
